extension.summary: Infinity runtime-aware Command Center, stability guard and diagnostics hub.
extension.description: Infinity Resume Hub 2 extends the existing local progress store with watched history, Watched/Unwatched, Watchlist, Collection, ratings, custom lists, Infinity Movies and Infinity TV routes, plus the existing Experience features. Trakt remains optional. Extends the existing progress, audio/subtitle memory, guardian and display controllers. Native Cobra and Kodi playback ownership are preserved.
